_doc: Scribe-lane voice + music presets (user, Nov 10). script.json "preset": "<voice>" fills the Fish voice + pacing keys (anything set in script.json wins); cues.json "music": {"preset": "<music>" | "auto"} picks the bed (auto = the voice preset's music). Music files are the user's ripped tracks in the GITIGNORED exports/music/ of the main checkout — never commit them (the repo is public). See CLAUDE.md → 'Scribe lane defaults'.

vex._doc: Vex / goth girl / 'goth mommy' default: Fish Dolly at a REGULAR pace, a normal cute girl, not breathy. speed 1.2 + fish.tempo 1.2 = ~3.3 words/s in a real reel (083: tempo 1.0 gave only 2.8).

vex-sua._doc: Vex in the 'Sua shy voice' the user linked (Nov 10; 081). Already quick: keep speed ~1.0.

narrator-chinese._doc: The user's favourite narrator (#8 'chinese'): fast, funny. Jokes stay about the TOPIC, never the accent.

narrator-chinese-2._doc: #7 'Chinese accent' (sounds like Uncle Roger; the user okayed it for ads Nov 10). Never reference Uncle Roger or his bits.

narrator-indian._doc: Indian-accent narrator, default = 'Amir' (fast, friendly). Alternates from the Nov 10 audition: 'Funny Indian accent' 8e468a7c906648e3bb4cb7c08185b14a (panicky, high), 'Mark' edb4d200ed2f4eb8b9b58dd042e21c6a (young, hyped).

narrator-slax._doc: Slax, the original f-word narrator (American). Synth score or no music; the phonk is for the accent narrators only.

phonk._doc: TIKI TIKI phonk (slowed) — ONLY under the Chinese/Indian-accent narrator reels.

cute._doc: Cute tracks for every Vex / goth girl reel (the user will send more: add them to files). Picked per video by a stable hash of the folder name, or "pick": i. Tracks differ in loudness (cute circus is ~4 dB quieter than ZOOM UP): measure the stems and land the music ~8 dB under the voice (081 ZOOM UP file_gain_db -8.5, 083 cute circus -4.5, both with stem music -11).
